proposition_note: je propose: pipeline stage thresholds governing PASS/HOLD/BLOCK transitions only; gate verdicts never emit or modify cell terrain confidence.

G0_INGEST.description: Evaluates raw DTM & telemetry input provenance, Mars sphere R=3,396,190m CRS, and nodata fraction.

G1_CLASSIFY.description: je propose: discrete stage gate checking grid step <= 8m, mean_cell_i < 0.35, and even-sol TEST validation MAE <= 4.5 deg without fabricating terrain T/I/F.

G2_SEARCH.description: Evaluates scout rover & astronaut A* path existence, safety margins (<20 deg, <=2 km), and +/-10% cost sensitivity.

G3_PLAN.description: Evaluates final crewed EVA sortie plan: walkback <= 2000m, duration <= 8h, radiation budget, and all stops <= 2000m.
